key_idea: The non-local interaction terms in a localized virial identity are controlled by expressing them as an expectation over lines and applying a 1D interval overlap inequality to the level sets of the sources.
reason: The proof introduces a highly surprising cross-field idea—using 1D integral geometry and line slicing to evaluate a PDE virial identity—which elegantly circumvents the lack of a priori decay at infinity. However, rigorously implementing this insight requires a dense chain of technical lemmas and substantial analytical bookkeeping.
